summary: BUG FIX VERIFIED: 'Impossibile caricare le password' error alert no longer appears on logout. Reproduced the original scenario (login → home with existing passwords → click logout icon top-right) on the deployed preview URL using Playwright at 375x667 mobile viewport. After login with NewPass456, /home rendered the TEST_Gmail entry correctly. Clicking the logout icon at the top-right of the header cleanly navigated to /login with ZERO alert dialogs (window.dialog listener recorded [] during and after logout). Screenshot confirms the login screen ('Password Manager' / 'Inserisci la tua password master' / 'Accedi' / 'Password dimenticata?') is displayed with no error overlay. Code review of the fix in /app/frontend/app/home.tsx confirms three defensive layers: (1) useFocusEffect line 34-40 guards `if (masterPassword) loadPasswords()`, (2) loadPasswords line 47-51 early-returns when !masterPassword, and (3) catch block line 55-60 only fires Alert.alert when masterPassword is still truthy. The logout() in AuthContext synchronously sets masterPassword to null before router.replace('/login') is invoked. No regressions observed: search bar, category filter chip, TEST_Gmail card, and FAB all render correctly on home before logout. Only pre-existing non-blocking RN-web console warnings ('shadow*' style props deprecated) were observed — same as iteration 5, unrelated to this fix.

critical_code_review_comments: home.tsx: The three-layer defense (useFocusEffect guard on line 36, loadPasswords early-return on line 47, catch-block Alert guard on line 58) is correct and idiomatic for the logout-during-focus race described in the bug. Fix is minimal and low-risk.

home.tsx line 58 (`if (masterPassword)` inside catch): masterPassword is captured by the closure of the render that invoked loadPasswords. If a fetch is truly in flight when logout occurs, this closure will still hold the OLD (non-null) value and would still fire the Alert. In practice this is mitigated because the logout button also calls router.replace('/login'), so the home screen unmounts before the Alert can render. Consider replacing the closure check with a ref (masterPasswordRef.current) if a truly race-safe guard is required.

home.tsx: The logout onPress at line 205-208 calls logout() then router.replace('/login') synchronously. Because setMasterPassword(null) is queued for the next render, useFocusEffect will observe the change and skip loadPasswords on next focus — this is what the fix relies on and it works.
AuthContext.tsx logout() is a plain state setter and does not await anything — appropriate for the current fix.

rca_of_issue: ORIGINAL BUG: Alert.alert('Errore', 'Impossibile caricare le password') was firing on logout. RCA: useFocusEffect on /home invoked loadPasswords() unconditionally; after logout() cleared masterPassword and router.replace('/login') was called, the focus-effect dependency change re-triggered the callback (or an in-flight fetch settled) with masterPassword=null, causing api.getAllPasswords to return 401 and the catch branch to show the alert. FIX APPLIED (already in place, verified): (1) useFocusEffect callback guards `if (masterPassword)` before calling loadPasswords, (2) loadPasswords early-returns when !masterPassword, (3) catch branch gates Alert.alert on `if (masterPassword)`. VERIFICATION: Playwright test on preview URL — logged in, saw home + password list, clicked logout icon, observed URL transitioned to /login with dialog listener capturing 0 alerts. RESULT: bug is resolved.
